$comment: S05 Open-Meteo ensemble (T052). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s05.yaml.

fields.name: cell_id
fields.meaning: om_ecmwf_ifs025_ensemble_<lat>N_<lon>E, the grid point the API snapped to

fields.name: member_id
fields.meaning: Series suffix as returned: 00 for the unsuffixed series, else NN from _memberNN; the count is read from each response

fields.name: model
fields.meaning: ecmwf_ifs025_ensemble, the one named model requested

fields.name: rain_mm
fields.meaning: precipitation over the preceding hour in mm (the API interpolates 3-hourly steps to 1 hour)

issued_at: last_run_initialisation_time from data/ecmwf_ifs025_ensemble/static/meta.json, read before and after the call
available_at: the later of last_run_availability_time + 10 minutes and the fetch time
missing: Hours before the run or at/after its exclusive data_end_time belong to another run: all-null with issued_at null, out_of_coverage, flags missing and stale. A null value gives out_of_coverage; negative rain gives quality_rejected
